About this Event

Rosé Namaste
Celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month: Get ready to unwind and vibe at Rosé Namaste – the ultimate in-person chill session! Stretch out with some relaxing yoga, and join us some refreshing drinks and lunch. 

Latinx Bigs is hosting Rosé Namaste, an adults-only yoga and networking experience at Baby Cobra Yoga in the East Village. It's an afternoon to celebrate the volunteers who give their time to our youth, welcome new members into our community, and share why mentorship matters so deeply in the Latinx community. Come move, connect, and be part of work that genuinely changes young lives across NYC. We'd love to have you with us.
Big Brothers Big Sisters of NYC creates and supports one-to-one mentoring relationships that ignite the power and promise of youth across the five boroughs. For over a century, we've matched young people with caring adult mentors who help them expand their horizons, realize their potential, and build brighter futures.
Latinx Bigs is one of our volunteer-led affinity groups, working to ensure Latinx youth in NYC have access to positive role models who reflect their culture and community. Throughout the year, in partnership with our corporate and community sponsors, Latinx Bigs hosts events that celebrate Latinx culture, uplift the community, and recruit the mentors our young people need.
